# .github — Account defaults and publication surface

## Scope

KooshaPari owns its public profile/site; .github publishes appropriate reusable account defaults; PhenoRegistry supplies approved metadata.

## Current evidence and unresolved obligations

See [the source-grounded state](STATE.md). Recent history adds profile content, but the pinned root README still says long pause and ARCHIVED / RETIRED.

## Explanatory atlas

Map actual artifact classes, entrypoints, build membership, consumers, state ownership, constraints and historical source identities. Every material path receives a reason and evidence status; generated/vendored artifacts inherit generator/upstream provenance rather than repetitive prose. Exclusion from a build is not a completeness decision. Investigate unknown intent and compatibility before deletion.

## QA and documentation

Use native tools, meaningful positive/negative fixtures, approved independent denominators and actual clean consumers. Record missing platforms and failed/skipped checks explicitly. Preserve inherited stronger source/intent systems. Tools must remain reusable for an unrelated project. All required public claims and critical contracts need complete applicable proof.

## Reuse and evolution

Evaluate mature external and owned upstreams before implementing another parser, scheduler, registry or renderer. Distinguish source ownership from distribution, and current users from plausible future extension. New work must reduce overall maintenance rather than forcing wrappers and migrations on every consumer. Avoid a universal database or forced all-workspace release.

## Bounded pilot

The [pilot record](PILOT.json) defines a proposed task and negative cases. It is not a result. Use the current simplest correct workflow as baseline, then demonstrate any proposed automation or shared-library improvement using real consumers.

## Parent acceptance

An actual consumer sees the intended defaults and the correct public profile, with no conflicting lifecycle instruction.

## Work

Use [the prioritized owner actions](NEXT-ACTIONS.md). Full product/foundation horizons remain retained, but no arbitrary new repository, migration or destructive action is authorized here.

## Shared policy

Apply [ecosystem-first evolution](../../architecture/ECOSYSTEM-FIRST-EVOLUTION.md): external and owned reuse before handroll, coordinated current/future-consumer improvements, and no local simplification that exports a larger burden.
